```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(glue)
library(here)
library(conflicted)

source(here::here("R/utils.R"))
source(here::here("R/utils_viz.R"))

# Helper function for computing differences
compute_differences <- function(data, metrics) {
  # First, aggregate
  agg_data <- data %>%
    group_by(subject, roi, P, T, S) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(metrics), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

  # Pivot wider - this creates columns like metric_prestim, metric_stim
  wide_data <- agg_data %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = S,
      values_from = all_of(metrics),
      names_glue = "{.value}_{S}" # Explicit naming
    )

  # Debug: print column names to see what we actually have
  cat("Columns after pivot_wider:", paste(names(wide_data), collapse = ", "), "\n")

  # Compute differences for each metric
  for (metric in metrics) {
    stim_col <- paste0(metric, "_stim")
    prestim_col <- paste0(metric, "_prestim")
    diff_col <- paste0(metric, "_diff")

    # Check if columns exist
    if (stim_col %in% names(wide_data) && prestim_col %in% names(wide_data)) {
      wide_data[[diff_col]] <- wide_data[[stim_col]] - wide_data[[prestim_col]]
    } else {
      warning(glue("Missing columns for {metric}: looking for {stim_col} and {prestim_col}"))
      cat("Available columns:", paste(names(wide_data), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    }
  }

  wide_data
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# COMPUTE DIFFERENCES (WITHIN-SUBJECT)
# ============================================================================

# Load ITPC data
itpc <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/Destrieux_final_itpc.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(type %in% c("prestim_itpc", "stim_itpc")) %>%
  mutate(
    S = case_when(
      type == "prestim_itpc" ~ "prestim",
      type == "stim_itpc" ~ "stim",
      TRUE ~ type
    ),
    itpc = value
  ) %>%
  select(subject, roi, P, T, S, itpc) %>%
  distinct()


itpc_diff <- compute_differences(itpc, "itpc")
# ============================================================================
# VISUALIZATION
# ============================================================================


p_itpc <- plot_condition_comparison(
  data = itpc_diff,
  metric = "itpc",
  metric_label = "ITPC"
)
p_itpc


```

```{r}


# ============================================================================
# COMPUTE DIFFERENCES (WITHIN-SUBJECT)
# ============================================================================
# Load specparam data
specparam <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/specparam_all.csv")) %>%
  mutate(S = condition) %>%
  select(subject, roi, P, T, S, exponent, error, offset) %>%
  distinct()

specparam_diff <- compute_differences(specparam, c("exponent", "offset"))

# ============================================================================
# VISUALIZATION
# ============================================================================


p_exponent <- plot_condition_comparison(
  data = specparam_diff,
  metric = "exponent",
  metric_label = "Aperiodic Exponent"
)
p_exponent
p_offset <- plot_condition_comparison(
  data = specparam_diff,
  metric = "offset",
  metric_label = "Spectral Offset"
)
p_offset
```

```{r}
  significance_threshold = 0.975,
  rba_base <- here::here("notebooks")

)

run_rba <- function(cfg, atlas_df = desterieux) {
   results <- with(cfg, {
    rba_data <- prepare_rba_data(data, metric)
    model_name <- glue("{name}_rba")
    cat(glue("\n=== Running RBA for {name} ===\n"))
    run_rba_model(data = rba_data, 
                  model_name = model_name, 
                  dist_y = dist_y,
                  base_dir = rba_base)

    # assume this returns a list that includes $brain_plot
    extract_and_plot_rba(
      model_name = model_name,
      atlas_df = atlas_df,
      plot_title = plot_title,
      filltype = filltype,
      limits = limits,
      significance_threshold = significance_threshold,
      base_dir = rba_base
    )

    # return all you care about
   # list(model_name = model_name, fit = fit, plots = plots)
  })
}

itpc_rba <- run_rba(itpc_config )
itpc_rba$brain_plot
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# RBA ANALYSIS - UNIFIED WORKFLOW
# ============================================================================

# Average across P×T combinations
specparam_avg <- specparam_diff %>%
  group_by(subject, roi) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with(c("exponent", "offset")), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Define models to run
models_config <- list(
  exponent = list(
    data = specparam_avg,
    metric = "exponent",
    dist_y = "normal",
    plot_title = "Exponent Difference (stim - prestim)",
    filltype = "Blues",
    limits = NULL
  ),
  offset = list(
    data = specparam_avg,
    metric = "offset",
    dist_y = "normal",
    plot_title = "Offset Difference (stim - prestim)",
    filltype = "BuGn",
    limits = NULL
  )
)

# Run all models
results <- lapply(names(models_config), function(name) {
  config <- models_config[[name]]
  model_name <- glue("{metric}_rba")

  # Prepare data
  rba_data <- prepare_rba_data(config$data, config$metric)

  # Run model
  cat(glue("\n=== Running RBA for {metric} ===\n"))
  run_rba_model(
    data = rba_data,
    model_name = model_name,
    dist_y = config$dist_y
  )

  # Extract and visualize
  extract_and_plot_rba(
    model_name = model_name,
    atlas_df = desterieux,
    plot_title = config$plot_title,
    filltype = config$filltype,
    limits = config$limits
  )
})

# Name the results list
names(results) <- names(models_config)

# ============================================================================
# DISPLAY RESULTS
# ============================================================================

# Print summary for each model
for (name in names(results)) {
  cat(glue("\n=== {toupper(name)} Results ===\n"))
  cat(glue("Significant ROIs: {nrow(results[[name]]$significant_rois)}\n\n"))
  print(head(results[[name]]$significant_rois, 10))
  print(results[[name]]$brain_plot)
}
```
